reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 14 points better, in a game of about 223 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Nets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 84 times in 100, by about 12; most games like this end between 196 and 244 total points.

analyst.text: Brooklyn have lost four straight, held two team meetings after the rout by Chicago, and Julius Randle called that game 'embarrassing'; Jordi Fernandez has shaken up the lineup and starting point guard Nolan Traore hurt his hamstring. Randle faces Minnesota, the team that traded him, and both he and Michael Porter Jr. are on the trade block. Minnesota have won three of four without Anthony Edwards. The angle leans towards Minnesota.
